/**
 * pi-notifications core: shared types, sanitizer, backend detection,
 * notification session and per-trigger formatters.
 *
 * Content channel byte builders live in channels/, config in settings.ts, and
 * external-extension integrations in extensions/. All output goes through an
 * injectable Sink so every byte path is unit-testable without a terminal.
 * Protocol semantics verified against Kitty's OSC 99 spec and VS Code's OSC 99
 * handler (microsoft/vscode#294703) — see SPEC.md.
 */
import { AsyncQueue } from './async-queue.ts'

export type UpdateKind = 'open' | 'update' | 'close'

export type NotificationUpdate = {
    kind: UpdateKind
    title?: string
    body?: string
    /** Priority: low, normal, critical. */
    priority?: 'low' | 'normal' | 'critical'
    /** Only honor the notification when the terminal's focus state matches. */
    focus?: 'always' | 'unfocused' | 'invisible'
    /** Mute the notification sound. */
    silent?: boolean
}

export type Sink = (bytes: string) => void

export type Backend = 'osc99' | 'osc777' | 'herdr'

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Sanitizer — single choke point at the channel boundary.
// Strips C0 (U+0000–U+001F), DEL (U+007F), C1 (U+0080–U+009F) and the OSC 99
// field separator ';'. Keeps printable Unicode. Caps at the Kitty payload limit.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex -- intentional: the sanitizer strips control characters
const UNSAFE_RE = /[\u0000-\u001F\u007F\u0080-\u009F;]/gu

export const MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES = 2048

export const truncateUtf8 = (text: string, maxBytes = MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES): string => {
    const encoder = new TextEncoder()

    if (encoder.encode(text).length <= maxBytes) return text

    let out = ''
    for (const ch of text) {
        const next = out + ch

        if (encoder.encode(next).length > maxBytes) return out

        out = next
    }

    return out
}

export const sanitizeText = (text: string): string => {
    return truncateUtf8(text.replace(UNSAFE_RE, ''))
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Backend detection
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export const detectBackend = (): Backend => {
    if (process.env.HERDR_SOCKET_PATH !== undefined && process.env.HERDR_SOCKET_PATH !== '')
        return 'herdr'
    if (process.env.KITTY_WINDOW_ID !== undefined) return 'osc99'
    if (process.env.TERM_PROGRAM === 'vscode') return 'osc99'
    if (process.env.TERM_PROGRAM === 'ghostty') return 'osc777'

    return 'osc777'
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Notification session
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** One notification unit: exactly one channel consumes the pushed updates. */
export class NotificationSession {
    readonly queue: AsyncQueue<NotificationUpdate>

    constructor(readonly id: string) {
        this.queue = new AsyncQueue<NotificationUpdate>()
    }

    push(update: NotificationUpdate): void {
        this.queue.push(update)
    }

    end(): void {
        this.queue.end()
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Formatters (per-trigger → NotificationUpdate)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type WorkSummary = {
    turns: number
    errors: number
}

const plural = (n: number): string => {
    return n === 1 ? '' : 's'
}

export const formatWorkOpen = (): NotificationUpdate => ({
    kind: 'open',
    title: 'Pi working…',
    silent: true,
})

export const formatWorkError = (toolName: string): NotificationUpdate => ({
    kind: 'update',
    body: `tool ${toolName} failed`,
})

export type WorkProgress = {
    turns: number
    tools: number
    elapsedMs: number
}

/** `12s`, `1m 5s`, `1h 2m` — compact elapsed time for the progress line. */
export const formatElapsed = (ms: number): string => {
    const totalSeconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms / 1000))
    const h = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600)
    const m = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60)
    const s = totalSeconds % 60
    if (h > 0) return `${h}h ${m}m`
    if (m > 0) return `${m}m ${s}s`

    return `${s}s`
}

/** Per-turn progress: stats in the body, title stays clean. */
export const formatWorkProgress = ({
    turns,
    tools,
    elapsedMs,
}: WorkProgress): NotificationUpdate => ({
    kind: 'update',
    title: 'Pi working…',
    body: `turn ${turns} · ${tools} tool${plural(tools)} · ${formatElapsed(elapsedMs)}`,
    silent: true,
})

export const formatWorkClose = ({ turns, errors }: WorkSummary): NotificationUpdate => ({
    kind: 'close',
    title: errors > 0 ? `Pi ready · ${errors} error${plural(errors)}` : 'Pi ready',
    body: `${turns} turn${plural(turns)} · ${errors} error${plural(errors)}`,
})

export const formatAttention = (title: string, body: string): NotificationUpdate => ({
    kind: 'close',
    title,
    body,
    priority: 'critical',
})
